Americans across the board are souring on the economy and current administration, but this sentiment is especially shared by those who now feel remorse for their 2024 vote. Four-in-five (81%) Trump regretters rate the economy negatively, eight points higher than Americans overall (73%). Additionally, Trump regretters are feeling more down about their personal financial situations, with nearly seven-in-10 (69%) feeling uneasy, six points higher than Americans overall (63%).
